meta.title: PR item with no category shows only super admin and process validators

steps.note: Enable the required PR team-category filtering configuration before navigating.
Open Purchase Requisitions as the starting screen for the PR workflow.
Stay on the Open tab where PR-6 can be selected for assignment.

args.goal: Search for PR-6, show its line items, tick the checkbox for the PR-6 item with no category, click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, scroll through the complete Search a user list, and verify that every listed name is a super admin or process validator and that no other users are listed

steps.note: Perform and verify the unsupported PR item search, selection, assignment dialog, complete-list inspection, and role-based expected result in the buyer portal.
Confirm the assignment user-search control remains visible after the assignee list inspection.
